notes.title: V0.1.200 Major Demo Update
notes.content:
Greetings Commanders, 🫡

We’re excited to announce a major update to the demo! Our team has been hard at work improving the experience, and this latest update brings a host of new features to explore.

notes.title: Deep Fringe Kickstarter Soon! + New Regions Feature
notes.content:
Greetings Commanders, 🫡

What a journey it’s been! Not long ago, we hit 6,000+ wishlists thanks to you— a huge milestone for our small team. We even went out to celebrate with dinner (yes, we’re that excited). 😭

Now, we’re moving to the next big step: Kickstarter! This will help us bring even more awesome content to Deep Fringe and push the project further.

👉 [Support us by Following our Kickstarter page here] so you don’t miss launch day and those discounted early bird rewards. Every follow truly makes a difference. ❤️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115727/b75a30735e247d9d15317f9d22e19c20fd023d66.png

We are aiming to launch early this summer, targeting June/July. We will keep you updated! Today we’re also taking part in the Turn-Based Festival on Steam — welcome to all the new players discovering Deep Fringe! 👋

To build the hype a bit more, we’ve been working on some exciting new features. We were hoping to keep them a surprise… but let’s just say we couldn’t wait.

🌌 Expanding Levels — Enter the Regions
Levels are evolving in a big way. We’re introducing Regions — once you complete one, a brand new map opens up, expanding your adventure deeper into the Fringe. More variety, more challenges, more tactical chaos. Three regional maps are planned for a future update to the demo. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115727/2d6edceb4f64845dceeb6e2050f80155048be87f.gif

🛠️ Level Editor Overhaul
We’re also updating the Level Editor with a brand-new HUD and improved usability. Whether you're a seasoned designer or just curious, it’ll be easier than ever to create and share your own maps. We are also working on giving the UI a more premium touch. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45115727/4de89624a62b0ed1bbbc1f729b49442d834a0eb8.gif

We can’t thank you enough for the continued support. If you know any friends who’d love Deep Fringe, please spread the word — every share means a lot to us.

We’re incredibly excited for the Kickstarter launch and hopeful we’ll reach our goal to make Deep Fringe bigger and better. More updates are coming soon — so stay tuned.

In the meantime, come say hi on Discord and check out our brand-new Twitter page.

See you on the field, Commanders.
– The Deep Fringe Team

notes.title: Demo Changes and Future Plans
notes.content:
Hello Commanders,🪖

First off, a massive thank you to everyone who played the demo and shared their thoughts with us. Your support, feedback, and encouragement mean the world to our small team.  

It’s been amazing to see how many of you connected with the gameplay, the tactical systems, the unit variety, and the art style. Your enthusiasm reminds us why we’re making this game.

Over the past two weeks, we’ve received tons of valuable feedback. While we’re thrilled that many of you enjoyed the core gameplay, we also heard concerns—especially around the way the story is presented. And we agree. 🫡


Demo – Big Changes Incoming
While we recognize that the story and presentation need improvement, we’ve decided to keep the demo live for those who still want to experience the gameplay and get a feel for Deep Fringe. That said, we know the current structure and dialogue aren’t quite where they need to be. We’re already working on changes to make the narrative more immersive and better aligned with the game loop — something that complements the experience instead of interrupting it. With that in mind, we’ll be taking some time over the coming months to focus on improving it, and we truly appreciate everyone’s patience as we work to make it better.

If you want to add more feedback, join us on Discord or through the following SURVEY.


Development Plan
We have collected a large number of optimization suggestions and problem feedback in the past two weeks. In terms of negative experiences, feedback on plot performances and texts is the most concentrated. We will gradually present the story through the gameplay and environment within the levels, reduce ambiguous dialogues and frequent load - ings, and strive to achieve a smooth and clear plot experience. Here are some of the things that we will be working on:


 Reduce the AVG - style dialogue performances.
 Increase the narrative of levels and the environment, and reduce the interruption of operations and processes.
 Simplify the concepts and technical terms to make the text more concise.
 Implement a new level architecture to support the progressive exploration of a large - scale level by zones.
 Update the styles of various text boxes.


V0.1.106 Update Log

New Features & Modifications

 The UI of the map editor has been updated.
 Newly created maps are now saved in a separate preset folder.
 The map editor now supports direct access to specified levels.
 The map editor now allows the selection of deployable units per level.
 Some advanced equipment now requires specific materials for purchase.
 The purchase interface has been updated.
 Item details are now displayed when hovering over them in the store.
 Enemy-dropped items have been adjusted to only include exchange materials usable in the store.
 Currency resource colours have been adjusted across the UI.
 Updated in-game operation instructions.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed incorrect buy-back prices in the store.
 Fixed item tab issues on the preparation interface.


Known Issues

 Some plot elements and writing are still unclear.
 Certain sound effects are missing.
 UI lacks animations.
 Some icons are still placeholders.


Thanks again for sticking with us! We’re committed to making this the best game it can be, and we can’t wait to share more soon. Don't forget to join the Discord Community. We've made some changes to the server to make it more enjoyable for everyone.

P.S. We’ve got something exciting coming soon… 🤫 a Kickstarter announcement is on the horizon — stay tuned for the full reveal! - You could even sneakily follow our page already… 👀

– The Deep Fringe Team
Discord

notes.title: Deep Fringe Public Demo Now Available!
notes.content:
Hi Commander,

 The Deep Fringe Demo is available on Steam Now!

Step into the war-torn wasteland, where survival is brutal, and strategy is everything. ☣️👇

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3073010

This early build is just the beginning, and we’d love to hear your thoughts! You can leave a review on our demo page or send feedback through our survey listed below. Every bit helps shape the future of Deep Fringe!

And if you can, please show us some support by wishlist us on Steam, it really makes a difference for small indie projects like us and we couldn't thank you enough for that! 🫡

[previewyoutube=RKLqnMjWHis;full][/previewyoutube]

In this Demo you can expect:
💥 Pushing, burning, blasting, and chainsawing anything in YOUR WAY!
⏳ 4 Story missions x 12 Combat Missions
🤖 Recruitable units—and a few surprises (yes, including a giant scorpion)
⚙ Basic Character Development & Equipment System
☢️ Camp Building & Resource Management System
🧩 Explore the level editor with all assets available 
And More tactical mayhem to discover!

Demo Feedback & BUGs 
For all feedback related to Deep Fringe demo, please fill out our Demo experience SURVEY.

If you would like to report any bugs encountered during your gameplay, please report it through our official Discord server, as well as on Steam discussion forum.

Difference between Playtest and Demo
The playtest is there so we can get help testing features still in development, but it’s less stable than the demo. For the best experience, we recommend trying the demo on launch — it’s more polished and helps us reach more players through visibility. 

Known Issues
1️⃣ The story is a work in progress—we’re refining it to make it awesome!
2️⃣ Some AI behaviors and skills may have bugs.
3️⃣ A few sound effects are still in production.
4️⃣ Some skill sequences and prompts may not trigger correctly.
5️⃣ There may be mistakes in the localization or issues with text formatting.

We’ve been working tirelessly over the past few weeks, pushing updates! That means you might run into some bugs, optimization issues, or localization errors. Your feedback is incredibly valuable, and we’ll be rolling out updates based on community reports.

P.S.
Apologies if the demo app name is displaying in CN for everyone. We’re working with Valve to add a localized English version.

Thank you for your support! See you in the wasteland, Commander. 🪖
